description:
🎤 Join the Samsung Bespoke AI Song Challenge!

Ready to own the stage? As part of the official Why Samsung campaign, we are launching a global challenge!
Choose your favorite track from the 3 Samsung Bespoke AI Songs, record yourself singing, and share your video on social media for a chance to win exciting prizes.

Q. How to Participate in the Challenge?
1. Pick at least one of the 3 “Samsung Bespoke AI Song” and film yourself singing it.
2. Post the video to your personal social media account.
3. Include the mandatory hashtags and tag Samsung's official accounts.

Q. When is the Campaign?
July 13, 2026 – August 31, 2026

Q. What are the Mandatory Tags?
Hashtags: #BespokeAISong #WhySamsung #BespokeAIAppliances #BespokeAI #Samsung

Listen to the Samsung Bespoke AI Songs now and create your own unique stage!
👉 Download Sheet Music & Instrumental Tracks: http://smsng.co/6055BETEUx
